title: Kth Largest Element In An Array
description: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array using the Quickselect algorithm.
pseudocode:
1. function quickselect(arr, k):
2.   pivot = arr[last]
3.   partition into left (smaller) and right (larger)
4.   if k <= right.length: return quickselect(right, k)
5.   else if k == right.length + 1: return pivot
6.   else: return quickselect(left, k - right.length - 1)
